methodology.model: EWMA/VaR cyclical short BTC futures/perpetual proxy
methodology.ewma: Classic recursive EWMA over BTC cycle returns with first 12 BTC cycle returns used as initial sample variance.
methodology.warmup: No EWMA/VaR hedge is applied for the first 12 cycles. Cycle 13 uses the initialized variance.
methodology.update: ewmaVar_t = lambda * ewmaVar_{t-1} + (1 - lambda) * btcReturn_{t-1}^2 after the first post-warm-up cycle.
methodology.hedgeRatio: hedgeRatio = max(0, 1 - maxLossBudgetPct / (z * ewmaVol)); no hard maximum cap in Phase 1B.
